## Pixel positions

$$
\text{Pixel positions in a perfectly linear image grid H}_{\text{LG}} : \\
x_{pixel} = \beta_{0x} + \beta_{xx}*x_{array} \\
H_{LG} \models \beta_{xy} = 0 \\
\Rightarrow  \Delta x_{pixel}=0 \ \mid \ x_{array} = i \\

y_{pixel} = \beta_{0y} + \beta_{yy}*y_{array} \\
H_{LG} \models \beta_{yx} = 0 \\
\Rightarrow \Delta y_{pixel}=0 \ \mid \ y_{array} = j \\

\text{Observed pixel-grid aspect ratio:} \\
R_{pixel} = \frac{\tilde{d}_{x, pixel}}{\tilde{d}_{y, pixel}}
$$

`pixel_deviations()`
      $\downarrow$ 
Residual image-coordinate deviation in tissue
positions after accounting for affine transformation.

```{r}

#--------------------------------------------------------------#
# JSON-TP pixel Validation
#--------------------------------------------------------------#

visium_ids <- list("Visium_6500"= "tissue_positions_list.csv",
                   "Visium_11000"="tissue_positions.csv")

tp_list <- list()
json_validation <- list()
summary_list <- list()
for (visium_id in seq_along(visium_ids)){
  visium_sample <- names(visium_ids)[[visium_id]]
  tp_file <- visium_ids[[visium_id]]
  # load tp & scalefactors
  tp <- load_tp(visium_dir=visium_dir, visium_sample=visium_sample, tp_file_name = tp_file)
  sf <-  jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(visium_dir, visium_sample, "outs", "spatial", "scalefactors_json.json"))
  # convert full resolution pixels into image resolution pixels
  tp$hires_imageX <- tp$pxl_col_in_fullres*sf$tissue_hires_scalef
  tp$hires_imageY <- tp$pxl_row_in_fullres*sf$tissue_hires_scalef
  tp$lowres_imageX <- tp$pxl_col_in_fullres*sf$tissue_lowres_scalef
  tp$lowres_imageY <- tp$pxl_row_in_fullres*sf$tissue_lowres_scalef
  # combine with json information
  json_file <- json_list[[visium_sample]]
  tp <- merge(tp, json_file$oligo, by.x = c("array_row", "array_col"), by.y= c("row", "col"))
  
  # fit linear model
  fit_x <- stats::lm(imageX ~ pxl_col_in_fullres, data=tp)
  fit_y <- stats::lm(imageY ~ pxl_row_in_fullres, data = tp)
  fit_xy <- stats::lm(imageX ~ pxl_col_in_fullres + pxl_row_in_fullres, data = tp)
  fit_yx <- stats::lm(imageY ~ pxl_col_in_fullres + pxl_row_in_fullres, data = tp)
  
  # build transformation matrix B
  cx <- coef(fit_xy)
  cy <- coef(fit_yx)
  
  B <- matrix(c(cx["pxl_col_in_fullres"], cx["pxl_row_in_fullres"], cx["(Intercept)"],
                cy["pxl_col_in_fullres"], cy["pxl_row_in_fullres"], cy["(Intercept)"],
                0, 0, 1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  
  # add residuals to tp
  tp$residuals_x <- residuals(fit_x)
  tp$residuals_y <- residuals(fit_y)
  tp$residual_distance <-  sqrt((tp$imageX - predict(fit_xy))^2 + (tp$imageY - predict(fit_yx))^2)
  tp_list[[visium_sample]] <- tp
  
  json_validation[[visium_sample]] <- list("x"= list(lm = fit_x,
                                                     lm_xy = fit_xy,
                                                     diff_hires = summary(tp$hires_imageX - tp$imageX),
                                                     diff_lowres = summary(tp$lowres_imageX - tp$imageX),
                                                     abs_diff_hires = summary(abs(tp$hires_imageX - tp$imageX)),
                                                     abs_diff_lowres = summary(abs(tp$lowres_imageX - tp$imageX)),
                                                     cor_hires = cor(tp$hires_imageX, tp$imageX),
                                                     cor_lowres = cor(tp$lowres_imageX, tp$imageX)),
                                           "y"= list(lm = fit_y,
                                                     lm_xy = fit_yx,
                                                     diff_hires = summary(tp$hires_imageY - tp$imageY),
                                                     diff_lowres = summary(tp$lowres_imageY - tp$imageY),
                                                     abs_diff_hires = summary(abs(tp$hires_imageY - tp$imageY)),
                                                     abs_diff_lowres = summary(abs(tp$lowres_imageY - tp$imageY)),
                                                     cor_hires = cor(tp$hires_imageY, tp$imageY),
                                                     cor_lowres = cor(tp$lowres_imageY, tp$imageY)),
                                           "B"= B)}

saveRDS(json_validation, file.path(tm_dir, "json_tp_transformation.rds"))



# residual plots for both samples
grDevices::png(filename = file.path(figures_dir, "residual_plots.png"), width=15, height=7, units = "cm", res=600)
par(mfrow=c(2,1))

visium_samples <- c("Visium_6500", "Visium_11000")
for (visium_sample in visium_samples){
  tp <- tp_list[[visium_sample]]
  fit_x_raw <- json_validation[[visium_sample]]$x$lm_xy
  fit_y_raw <- json_validation[[visium_sample]]$y$lm_xy
  
  # create residual summary df
  df <- data.frame(matrix(nrow=3, ncol=length(summary(1))), row.names = c("residuals_x_raw", "residuals_y_raw", "residual_distance"))
  colnames(df) <- c("min", "median", "mean", "sd", "max")
  df[1,] <- summary(residuals(fit_x_raw))
  df[2,] <- summary(residuals(fit_y_raw))
  df[3,] <- summary(tp$residual_distance)
  
  # create plot
  enlargement_factor <- 20
  
  plot(tp$imageX, tp$imageY, asp = 1, pch = 16, cex = 0.3)
  
  graphics::segments(tp$imageX,
                     tp$imageY,
                     tp$imageX + enlargement_factor * (tp$imageX - predict(fit_x_raw)),
                     tp$imageY + enlargement_factor * (tp$imageY - predict(fit_y_raw)), col = "blue")
  
  # add residual summaries as tables
  graphics::frame()
  vps <- gridBase::baseViewports()
  grid::pushViewport(vps$inner, vps$figure, vps$plot)
  grob <-  gridExtra::tableGrob(df)  
  grid::grid.draw(grob)
  
  grid::popViewport(3)}

grDevices::dev.off()

```

#--------------------------------------------------------------#
# Internal JSON Validation
#--------------------------------------------------------------#

slide_ids <-list("Visium_FFPE_Human_Ovarian_Cancer" = "V10L13-020-D1",
                 "CytAssist_11mm_FFPE_Human_Ovarian_Carcinoma" = "V52Y09-003-B1")

json_transformation <- list()
json_list <- list()
for (slide in seq_along(slide_ids)){
  visium_sample <- names(slide_ids)[slide]
  slide_id <- slide_ids[[slide]]
  json_file <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(tm_dir, visium_sample, paste0(slide_id, ".json")))
  json_list[[visium_sample]] <- json_file
  A <- json_file$transform
  oligo <- json_file$oligo
  fid <- json_file$fiducial
  
  # line stats
  fit_x <- stats::lm(imageX ~ x + y, data = oligo)
  fit_y <- stats::lm(imageY ~ x + y, data = oligo)
  
  line_stats <- list(
    "slideX_col" = oligo %>%
      dplyr::group_by(col) %>%
      dplyr::reframe(n = dplyr::n(),
                     mean = mean(x),
                     median = median(x),
                     sd = stats::sd(x),
                     mad = stats::mad(x),
                     min = min(x),
                     max = max(x),
                     diff_range = diff(range(x))),
    "slideY_row" = oligo %>%
      dplyr::group_by(row) %>%
      dplyr::reframe(n = dplyr::n(),
                     mean = mean(y),
                     median = median(y),
                     sd = stats::sd(y),
                     mad = stats::mad(y),
                     min = min(y),
                     max = max(y),
                     diff_range = diff(range(y))),
    "imageX_row" = oligo %>%
      dplyr::group_by(row) %>%
      dplyr::reframe(n = dplyr::n(),
                     mean = mean(imageX),
                     median = median(imageX),
                     sd = stats::sd(imageX),
                     mad = stats::mad(imageX),
                     min = min(imageX),
                     max = max(imageX),
                     diff_range = diff(range(imageX))),
    "imageY_col" =oligo %>%
      dplyr::group_by(col) %>%
      dplyr::reframe(n = dplyr::n(),
                     mean = mean(imageY),
                     median = median(imageY),
                     sd = stats::sd(imageY),
                     mad = stats::mad(imageY),
                     min = min(imageY),
                     max = max(imageY),
                     diff_range = diff(range(imageY))),
    "lm_x"=fit_x,
    "residual_misalignment_x"=unname(coef(fit_x)["y"]),
    "dx_image"=unname(coef(fit_x)["x"]),
    "lm_y"=fit_y,
    "residual_misalignment_y"=unname(coef(fit_y)["x"]),
    "dy_image"=unname(coef(fit_y)["y"]),
    "dx:dy_image_ratio"= abs(unname(coef(fit_x)["x"])/unname(coef(fit_y)["y"])))
  
  # Distance between adjacent lines
  median_diff <- list()
  line_ids <- grep("_col|row", names(line_stats), value = TRUE)
  for (line_id in line_ids){
    median_diff[[line_id]] <- diff(line_stats[[line_id]]$median)}
  
  # add to line stats
  line_stats[["median_diff"]] <- median_diff
  
  # Observed grid-aspect ratio
  line_stats[["median_grid_ratio"]]<- list("slide"= median(abs(median_diff$slideX_col))/median(abs(median_diff$slideY_row)),
                                           "image" = median(abs(median_diff$imageY_col))/median(abs(median_diff$imageX_row)))
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------#
  
  # spatial models
  oligo_x <- stats::lm(x ~ col, data=oligo)
  oligo_y <- stats::lm(y ~ row, data = oligo)
  fid_x <- stats::lm(x ~ col, data=fid)
  fid_y <- stats::lm(y ~ row, data = fid)
  
  spatial_stats <- list("x"= list(oligo = oligo_x,
                                  dx_slide = unname(coef(oligo_x)["col"]),
                                  fiducials = fid_x,
                                  dx_fiducials = unname(coef(fid_x)["col"])),
                        "y"= list(oligo = oligo_y,
                                  dy_slide = unname(coef(oligo_y)["row"]),
                                  fiducials = fid_y,
                                  dy_fiducials = unname(coef(fid_y)["row"])))
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------#
  
  # neighbor distances
  axis_neighbors <- dplyr::inner_join(
    oligo, oligo %>% dplyr::transmute(row, col = col - 2L, x_2 = x, y_2 = y), by = c("row", "col"))
  
  axis_neighbors$distance <- sqrt(
    (axis_neighbors$x - axis_neighbors$x_2)^2 +
      (axis_neighbors$y - axis_neighbors$y_2)^2)
  
  diag_neighbors <- dplyr::inner_join(
    oligo, oligo %>% dplyr::transmute(row = row - 1L, col = col - 1L, x_2 = x, y_2 = y), by = c("row", "col"))
  
  diag_neighbors$distance <- sqrt(
    (diag_neighbors$x - diag_neighbors$x_2)^2 +
      (diag_neighbors$y - diag_neighbors$y_2)^2)
  
  neighbor_stats <- list("axis_neighbors"= axis_neighbors,
                         "diag_neighbors"= diag_neighbors)
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------#
  
  # Forward transformation
  # Convert layout coordinates to homogeneous coordinates
  v_oligo <- cbind(oligo[,c("x", "y")], "z"=1)
  v_oligo$pxl_x <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(v_oligo))
  v_oligo$pxl_y <-  rep(NA_real_, nrow(v_oligo))
  
  v_fid <- cbind(fid[,c("x", "y")], "z"=1)
  v_fid$pxl_x <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(v_fid))
  v_fid$pxl_y <-  rep(NA_real_, nrow(v_fid))
  
  # Transformation of spatial coordinates into pixel coordinates
  # Perform matrix-vector multiplication & re-combine with original output
  for (row in 1:nrow(v_oligo)){
    v <- unlist(unname(v_oligo[row,c("x", "y", "z")]))
    tv <- A %*% v
    v_oligo[row, c("pxl_x", "pxl_y")] <- tv[1:2]}
  v_oligo <- merge(oligo, v_oligo, by=c("x", "y"))
  
  for (row in 1:nrow(v_fid)){
    v <- unlist(unname(v_fid[row,c("x", "y", "z")]))
    tv <- A %*% v
    v_fid[row, c("pxl_x", "pxl_y")] <- tv[1:2]}
  v_fid <- merge(fid, v_fid, by=c("x", "y"))
  
  # save to list
  S2I <- list("A"=A, 
              "oligo"= v_oligo,
              "fiducial"=v_fid)
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------#
  
  # Backward transformation
  # calculate inverse transformation matrix
  A_inv <- solve(A)
  
  # Convert pixel coordinates to homogeneous coordinates
  v_oligo <- cbind(oligo[,c("imageX", "imageY")], "imageZ"=1)
  v_oligo$slide_x <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(v_oligo))
  v_oligo$slide_y <-  rep(NA_real_, nrow(v_oligo))
  
  v_fid <- cbind(fid[,c("imageX", "imageY")], "imageZ"=1)
  v_fid$slide_x <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(v_fid))
  v_fid$slide_y <-  rep(NA_real_, nrow(v_fid))
  
  # Transformation of spatial coordinates into pixel coordinates
  # Perform matrix-vector multiplication
  for (row in 1:nrow(v_oligo)){
    v <- unlist(unname(v_oligo[row,c("imageX", "imageY", "imageZ")]))
    tv <- A_inv %*% v
    v_oligo[row, c("slide_x", "slide_y")] <- tv[1:2]}
  v_oligo <- merge(oligo, v_oligo, by=c("imageX", "imageY"))
  
  for (row in 1:nrow(v_fid)){
    v <- unlist(unname(v_fid[row,c("imageX", "imageY", "imageZ")]))
    tv <- A_inv %*% v
    v_fid[row, c("slide_x", "slide_y")] <- tv[1:2]}
  v_fid <- merge(fid, v_fid, by=c("imageX", "imageY"))
  
  # save to list
  I2S <- list("A_inv"=A_inv,
              "oligo"= v_oligo,
              "fiducial"=v_fid)
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------#
  
  # save data
  json_transformation[[visium_sample]] <- list(slide2image = S2I,
                                               image2slide = I2S, 
                                               line_stats = line_stats,
                                               spatial_stats = spatial_stats,
                                               neighbor_stats = neighbor_stats)}

saveRDS(json_transformation, file.path(tm_dir, "json_internal_transformation.rds"))


#--------------------------------------------------------------#
# JSON-TP Validation
#--------------------------------------------------------------#

visium_ids <- list("Visium_6500"= "tissue_positions_list.csv",
                   "Visium_11000"="tissue_positions.csv")

tp_list <- list()
json_validation <- list()
summary_list <- list()
for (visium_id in seq_along(visium_ids)){
  visium_sample <- names(visium_ids)[[visium_id]]
  tp_file <- visium_ids[[visium_id]]
  # load tp & scalefactors
  tp <- load_tp(visium_dir=visium_dir, visium_sample=visium_sample, tp_file_name = tp_file)
  sf <-  jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(visium_dir, visium_sample, "outs", "spatial", "scalefactors_json.json"))
  # convert full resolution pixels into image resolution pixels
  tp$hires_imageX <- tp$pxl_col_in_fullres*sf$tissue_hires_scalef
  tp$hires_imageY <- tp$pxl_row_in_fullres*sf$tissue_hires_scalef

  # fit linear model

                                                     diff_lowres = summary(tp$lowres_imageY - tp$imageY),
                                                     abs_diff_hires = summary(abs(tp$hires_imageY - tp$imageY)),
